Signal is family-level (A1/A5/A6 indistinguishable). Oct schema: URL in $d.context.url (July used $d.url). Templateids were re-minted between July and Oct (e.g. 'http status code is' f19acea8 -> 33948266), so template ids are not stable across months.

detecting_query: source logs | filter $l.subsystemname == 'crawl-worker' && ($d.context.url:string ~ 'myprepaidcenter' || $d.url:string ~ 'myprepaidcenter') | groupby $m.templateid aggregate count() as n, substr(any_value($d.message:string),0,160) as sample

Rule for investigator: when a login selector fails, check for a 403/405 resource error on the same job first -> A1, not B2. 'http status code is:' line absent on interaction-flow pages.

detecting_query: source logs | filter $d.message:string ~ 'Connection is not available' || $d.message:string ~ 'create crawl request' | groupby $l.applicationname, $l.subsystemname aggregate count() as n, substr(any_value($d.message:string),0,200) as sample
notes: Platform-wide at that moment (both admin and front tenants affected), so the same signal also covers E1. The 1-2 day window before the ticket date (09-08..09-09) shows nothing; you must use the failing run time. METRIC_EVENT CrawlSummary (admin-server/front-server) is a structured per-crawl outcome record with propertyId+status - best entry point for 'crawl failed' tickets. A first query with a grouped regex '(A|B|C)' on admin-server+scrape-server returned 0 rows; separate '~' terms joined by || worked.

0 rows for LimitExceededException in admin+front 05-05..05-06, 0 rows for '(?i)natwest' in admin-server on 05-05, and admin-server has no 'state changed from' lines on 05-05 at all; crawl-worker had no logs in a sampled May hour (admin-server only, mostly poller noise). Early-May logs don't have the MDC/state-transition lines this ticket needs. Not a log-design gap for E4 itself, just retention/instrumentation age.

'element: #input-1, exists: true, in an iframe: false' x36 (first interaction step succeeds)

notes: Crawls with the interaction ran at the stated time, but the top-20 templates show no 'No element found for selector' line for the sc-… CLICK_ELEMENT. A stale selector that silently matches nothing or times out can end DONE with 0 URLs and no clear error. The decisive fact ('DONE with 0 URLs') likely sits in admin-server CrawlSummary METRIC_EVENT (totalUrlsCount=0), not in crawl-worker. Many concurrent Chick-fil-A crawls (www, 1346 pages) share the host; filter by k8s.job.name per property.
